bundle.longDescription: OpenObsidian — a local-first, MIT-licensed knowledge base where your plain markdown files are the single source of truth. Edit in a dual-mode editor (CodeMirror source + BlockNote WYSIWYG), navigate a Cytoscape graph of wikilinks and frontmatter relations, sketch on an Excalidraw canvas (MIT), and manage tabular data in a Sheet view — all on your own machine, no account or cloud sync required.
